description:
Create a new USER STORY under the connected project. `projectId` defaults to the current project.

**HIERARCHY — ALWAYS RESOLVE BEFORE CALLING.** A story lives under Epic → Feature → Story. Do NOT create orphan stories. Before calling this tool, confirm with the user which `epicId` and/or `featureId` the story belongs to. If the user has not told you: (1) ask them directly, or (2) if they name a parent, resolve the id via `epic_list` / `feature_list` first. When creating MULTIPLE stories from a BRD, group them under the same parent unless the BRD clearly splits them across features. Only skip parent linking if the user explicitly says "no parent" or "standalone".

`state` and `priority` default to the project-configured defaults when omitted; pass them only when overriding. Backend requires `name`, `estimatedEffort`. **`description` and `acceptanceCriteria` must BOTH be HTML (NOT markdown) — SQA UI renders them via a Tiptap editor and persists raw HTML. See each field docstring below for the exact allowed tags, required section structure, and Given/When/Then format for AC. One-line descriptions and 3-line AC lists are not acceptable.** `customFields` may be omitted — an empty object is sent automatically.

acceptanceCriteria.description:
REQUIRED-QUALITY: comprehensive Given/When/Then criteria as HTML (SQA UI renders through a Tiptap editor). Use
  • …
— one AC per
  • . Aim for 5–15 criteria; a BRD with 3 acceptance lines is a smell — expand implicit signals. Cover happy path, at least one alternative flow, error/validation cases, permission/role edges, boundary values. Format per
  • : "Given <precondition> When <action> Then <observable outcome>". Concrete example:
    • Given a user with an unverified email When they submit the login form Then the system displays Verify your email and does not create a session
    • Given a user with 5 failed login attempts in the last 15 minutes When they submit valid credentials Then the system responds 429 and locks the account for 30 minutes
    Do NOT emit markdown. Allowed tags: same allowlist as description. AVOID vague criteria ("Login works", "Errors are handled") — every
  • must be independently testable.

Structure:

      User Story

epicId.description: Parent epic numeric id. RESOLVE VIA `epic_list` OR ASK THE USER before creating — do not leave a story parent-less unless the user explicitly says "no parent".

featureId.description: Parent feature numeric id. RESOLVE VIA `feature_list` OR ASK THE USER before creating — a story typically lives under a feature. Skip only if the user explicitly says "no feature".

orphan.description: Set true ONLY if the user has explicitly said the story has no parent ("standalone", "no epic/feature"). Required when BOTH `epicId` and `featureId` are omitted — the tool refuses otherwise so orphan stories cannot be created silently from a BRD/BRS prompt.

priority.description: Optional. Defaults to the project-configured default story priority when omitted.

state.description: Optional. Defaults to the project-configured default story state when omitted.

watchList.description: Watch List (the UI email button): emails, full names or numeric userIds to receive notifications. Applied after creation.
